Task success rate.definition: Successful trials divided by total trials
Task success rate.denominator: all planned (scene, seed) trials for the arm and split; successes use the frozen final_can_outcome criteria

Prediction error.denominator: number of valid paired prediction steps per quantity (truthful truncated pairing, allow_truncated=True); unexecuted horizon steps excluded
Prediction error.unit: SI per quantity (m, rad) / steps [PROPOSED; OWNER DECISION]

Collision rate.definition: Trials with collisions divided by total trials; proxy hits are labelled, never silently promoted to verified contacts
Collision rate.denominator: all planned (scene, seed) trials for the arm and split; numerator is episodes with a labelled proxy hit and/or a backend-recorded contact

Path length.definition: Sum of distances along the executed trajectory
Path length.denominator: not a ratio; summed over recorded executed EE/tool trajectory segments only

Execution time.definition: Recorded simulation or wall-clock duration, clearly identified; sim and wall kept as separate channels
Execution time.denominator: not a ratio; per-episode clock, aggregated over trials by mean/std with n reported

Planning latency.definition: Time required to generate and evaluate candidates, measured from decision-sidecar phase timings; full-system latency remains UNVERIFIED until a real run exists
Planning latency.denominator: not a ratio; per-decision perf_counter_ns windows, aggregated by p50/p95 with the number of timed decisions reported

Risk rejection rate.definition: Rejected candidates divided by evaluated candidates
Risk rejection rate.denominator: all evaluated candidates across recorded decisions (candidate dispositions); hard-check vetoes counted separately from Eq. 3.8 ranking

Reliability.definition: Successful runs and documented failure categories
Reliability.denominator: all planned (scene, seed) trials; categories from evaluation_failure_category with raw failure_state preserved separately

failure_taxonomy.note: Proposal only; category granularity is an owner decision. Proxy hits and unverified-arm-sweep vetoes are channels, not silently merged into a single risk number.

measurement_instrumentation.note: Measured from recorded decisions; no decision count inferred from control steps, no latency taken from a nominal kernel profile.

evidence_sources.Task success rate: eval/metrics.py success aggregation and Wilson interval
evidence_sources.Collision rate: recorded displacement/tilt PROXY plus contact diagnostics; proxy must remain labelled
evidence_sources.Planning latency: decision sidecar phase timings; full-system latency remains UNVERIFIED
evidence_sources.Reliability: failure_states and evaluation_failure_category in frozen summaries
